head: makeART Coloring Book app for iPhone and iPad, with no ads
dek: makeART Coloring Book is a $7.99 colouring app for iPhone and iPad where you tap to fill pages or paint with brushes. It came out on 20 November and was #30 among paid Graphics & Design apps on the US App Store on 21 November.
details: It has its own drawn pages plus public-domain ones, and can turn any photo into a colouring page. Finished pictures can be shown in different styles and played back as a timelapse video. The listing says there's no account, no ads and no subscription, and everything stays on the device and works offline. It's made by Make Art Inc.
means: If you or your kids like colouring on a tablet, this is a one-price app without ads.
todo: Look at the sample pages on the App Store page before you buy; it's too new to have reviews.
